description: FREE. Slice the same model across several printers and get a table of print time / filament / cost / fits-on-bed, plus the cheapest and fastest picks. Paste a link: a GitHub blob, Google Drive or Dropbox share link, a direct .stl/.3mf/.obj/.ply/.step URL, or a .zip (first printable model inside is used). Thingiverse/Printables/MakerWorld pages usually block server downloads: download the file yourself and upload it. Local file? Upload once at https://fabtally.com/upload and paste that URL. Fair-use limited (counts as one slice per printer). Perfect for 'which of my printers should I use?'

currency.description: BYO pricing: currency code (USD, EUR, ...). Default USD. Only a label: amounts are NOT converted, so pass your own rates in that currency too.

filename.description: File name incl. extension, e.g. 'bracket.stl'. Required with model_base64.

layer_height.description: Explicit layer height mm; overrides `quality`. 0.04 up to the printer's max (0.3-0.4 mm on a 0.4 mm nozzle).

markup_percent.description: BYO pricing: extra % markup on top of margin.

material.description: Filament/material id (pla, pla-cf, petg, petg-cf, abs, abs-cf, asa, asa-cf, nylon, pc, pet, tpu). Default pla.

minimum_price.description: BYO pricing: per-unit price floor, applied after volume discounts.

model_base64.description: Base64 model bytes — small-file fallback only (roughly <50KB). MCP clients (Claude/ChatGPT Desktop) truncate large inline tool arguments, so a real STL can silently arrive corrupted. For anything bigger use model_url (upload at https://fabtally.com/upload first). Provide `filename` too.

model_url.description: PREFERRED. Public URL to the 3D model. Paste a link: a GitHub blob, Google Drive or Dropbox share link, a direct .stl/.3mf/.obj/.ply/.step URL, or a .zip (first printable model inside is used). Thingiverse/Printables/MakerWorld pages usually block server downloads: download the file yourself and upload it. Local file? Upload once at https://fabtally.com/upload and paste that URL. The server fetches and (if a zip) unpacks it.

printers.description: Comma-separated printer ids to compare (max 6), e.g. 'bambu-a1,prusa-mk4,ender3-v3'.

quality.description: Quality preset: draft 0.28mm | standard 0.20mm | fine 0.12mm layer height.

quantity.description: Number of parts (1-10000). Volume discounts apply. Default 1.

setup_fee.description: BYO pricing: flat setup fee, charged once per job (not per part).
